description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions within the OpenClaw project, covering date age formatting, SSH target parsing, connection settings, gateway entry point selection, and log file selection.

classes.name: UtilitiesTests
classes.description: A test suite aggregating various utility function tests for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: `age strings cover common windows`
methods.description: Tests the age formatting function for recent time differences.

methods.name: `parse SSH target supports user port and defaults`
methods.description: Validates SSH target parsing with user, host, and port parameters.

methods.name: `sanitized target strips leading SSH prefix`
methods.description: Checks the removal of SSH prefixes from target strings and loading of connection settings.

methods.name: `gateway entrypoint prefers dist over bin`
methods.description: Ensures the gateway entry point selection logic prefers 'dist/index.js' over 'bin/openclaw.js'.

methods.name: `log locator picks newest log file`
methods.description: Verifies that the log locator correctly identifies the most recently modified log file.

methods.name: `gateway entrypoint nil when missing`
methods.description: Confirms that missing gateway entry points are handled gracefully by returning nil.
